description: Trigger-quality cases for the model-invoked skills. should_trigger cases must route to their own skill; should_not_trigger cases must stay below threshold everywhere; near_neighbor cases must not steal routes from their confusable sibling. Every case derives from a real routing situation or a documented failure (see failures/). Every model-invoked skill carries at least three should_trigger cases here; the coverage test fails otherwise.
